stories.title: Fix IB contract conId qualification in get_snapshot_price
stories.goal: engine/data/market_data.py get_snapshot_price() calls _make_contract() which returns an unqualified Future with no conId. IB throws: 'Contract Future(symbol=MES) can't be hashed because no conId value exists'. Fix: use _resolve_front_month() for futures symbols in get_snapshot_price (same pattern as get_historical_bars). After fix, GET /data/price/{symbol} must return a numeric last_price for MCL and MNQ when IB Gateway is connected.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/data/market_data.py: get_snapshot_price() calls _resolve_front_month() for futures symbols (when symbol in FUTURES_MAP or is_futures=True)
No 'can't be hashed because no conId' error in engine logs after restart
GET /data/price/MCL returns {last_price: <float>, source: 'ibkr_snapshot'} when IB Gateway is on port 4002
GET /data/price/MNQ returns {last_price: <float>, source: 'ibkr_snapshot'} when IB Gateway is on port 4002
Fallback still works: if IB not connected, returns {last_price: null, source: 'ibkr_not_connected'}
cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with 0 failures
stories.notes: The fix is surgical — get_snapshot_price is ~30 lines. Change _make_contract call to await self._resolve_front_month(symbol, exchange) when is_futures or symbol in FUTURES_MAP. FUTURES_EXCHANGE dict is already in scope.

stories.title: Fix dashboard API key — verify NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_API_KEY in .env.local
stories.goal: Dashboard lib/api.ts reads process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_API_KEY and falls back to 'jarvis-dev-key-change-me' if not set. Engine logs show 'Invalid X-API-Key attempt from dashboard routes' — meaning the env var is not set in dashboard/.env.local. Fix: read engine/.env to get the real API_KEY value, then write dashboard/.env.local with NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_API_KEY=<that value>. Restart dashboard. Verify no more API key errors in engine log.
acceptanceCriteria: Read engine/.env to get the current API_KEY value
Write/update dashboard/.env.local: NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_API_KEY=<value from engine/.env>
Also set NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_URL=http://localhost:8010 if not already present
pnpm run build passes in dashboard/
After dashboard restart (pnpm dev), engine logs show NO 'Invalid X-API-Key' errors on dashboard route calls
GET /health from dashboard fetch succeeds (check browser network tab or engine access log)
stories.notes: engine/.env should have API_KEY=jarvis-dev-key-change-me. dashboard/lib/api.ts already has the correct env var name (NEXT_PUBLIC_ENGINE_API_KEY). Only the .env.local file is missing. DO NOT commit .env.local — it is gitignored.

stories.title: Close 4 stale MES test positions via management endpoint
stories.goal: 4 test MES positions are open in SQLite (paper_trades) and in-memory tracker from Sprint 18/19 testing. They pollute win-rate, profit-factor, and position count. Add POST /portfolio/paper/admin/close-stale endpoint that closes all open positions where symbol='MES' and entry_price=5800.0 with exit_price=entry_price (zero P&L). After calling it, GET /portfolio/paper/positions returns empty list, GET /paper/validation/summary returns trades_closed >= 1 (the real MCL trade), win_rate > 0.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /portfolio/paper/admin/close-stale endpoint added to engine/routers/portfolio_router.py (or paper_validation_router.py)

stories.title: Post-trade analysis dashboard page
stories.goal: Build dashboard/app/trades/page.tsx — a post-trade analysis page showing all closed paper trades from SQLite. Shows: trade_id, symbol, direction (LONG/SHORT), entry_price, exit_price, pnl ($), entry_time, exit_time, duration. Each row has a win/loss badge (green for pnl>0, red for pnl<=0). Page auto-refreshes every 30s. Uses GET /paper/trades/closed endpoint (add it if missing). Page linked in sidebar nav.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /paper/trades/closed endpoint exists in engine — returns array of closed paper_trades from SQLite ordered by exit_time DESC
dashboard/app/trades/page.tsx exists and renders the closed trades table
Table columns: Symbol | Direction | Entry | Exit | P&L | Duration | Closed At | Result
Result badge: variant='bull' for pnl>0, variant='bear' for pnl<=0, variant='neutral' for pnl=0
P&L formatted as $+100.00 or $-50.00 with color (green/red via badge)
Duration formatted as human-readable: '2h 14m' not raw seconds
Page auto-refreshes via useSWR with refreshInterval: 30000
Sidebar nav includes 'Trade History' link pointing to /trades

cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v passes
stories.notes: The endpoint query: SELECT * FROM paper_trades WHERE status='closed' ORDER BY exit_time DESC. The trade_id, symbol, action, entry_price, exit_price, pnl, entry_time, exit_time columns all exist. duration = (exit_time - entry_time) in seconds. Use fetchEngine<ClosedTrade[]>('/paper/trades/closed') in the dashboard component. Sidebar is in dashboard/app/layout.tsx or a shared nav component — find it and add the link.
